mapper.insert: INSERT INTO msf_user_hst ( user_id, cret_ip, cret_dt, cret_id, amd_ip, amd_dt, amd_id, user_nm, pwd, agent_cd, shop_cd, mobile_no, ip, email_adr, email_receive_yn, user_sttus_cd, access_limit_yn, access_limit_dt, login_chk_cnt, pwd_chg_yn, pwd_chg_dt, chg_dt ) SELECT user_id, cret_ip, cret_dt, cret_id, amd_ip, amd_dt, amd_id, user_nm, pwd, COALESCE(agent_cd, 'NONE'), shop_cd, mobile_no, ip, email_adr, email_receive_yn, user_sttus_cd, access_limit_yn, access_limit_dt, login_chk_cnt, pwd_chg_yn, pwd_chg_dt, chg_dt FROM msf_user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update msf_user_info set pwd = #{newPassword} , pwd_chg_dt = now() , pwd_chg_yn = 'Y' , login_chk_cnt = 0 where 1=1 and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select user_id , user_nm , agent_cd , shop_cd , mobile_no , ip , user_sttus_cd , access_limit_yn , COALESCE(login_chk_cnt, 0) + 1 as login_chk_cnt , pwd , case when pwd_chg_dt < now() - interval '3 months' then 'Y' else 'N' end as pwdChgYn from msf_user_info where 1=1 and user_id = #{userId}
select pwd from msf_user_hst where user_id = #{userId} and pwd_chg_yn = 'Y' order by amd_dt desc limit 1

mapper.update: update msf_admin_user_info set admin_pwd = #{newPassword} , pwd_chg_dt = now() , pwd_chg_yn = 'Y' , login_chk_cnt = 0 where 1=1 and admin_id = #{userId}
